svg.title: FreightLens extraction pipeline
svg.desc: A document is parsed, classified by an LLM, extracted by an LLM, then validated by code. If the totals do not add up, the document goes back to the extractor with a hint, at most twice, otherwise it goes to a human.
svg.text: How one document moves through the pipeline
A LangGraph state graph. graph.py wires the steps; the steps are plain functions in nodes.py.
retry, at most 2 times: back to the same extractor with a hint
only when the charge lines do not add up to the printed total
